subject: Lavaan warning: some estimated ov variances are negative

messages.author: c8172cf47ead82fa
messages.subject: Lavaan warning: some estimated ov variances are negative
parts:
I am testing the following model: 

full.model <- 'FMO =~ FMO1 + FMO2 + FMO3
              BP =~ BP1 + BP2 + BP3 + BP5
              GO =~ GO1 + GO2
              # direct effect
              BP ~ c(c1, c2) * FMO
              BP ~ c(d1, d2) * GO
              # mediator
              MCA ~ c(a1, a2) * FMO + c(e1,e2) * GO
              BP ~ c(b1, b2) * MCA
              # indirect effect (a*b)
              indirect1 := a1 * b1
              indirect2 := a2 * b2
              indirect3 := e1 * b1
              indirect4 := e2 * b2
              #total effect
              total1 := c1 + (a1 * b1)
              total2 := c2 + (a2 * b2)
              total3 := d1 + (e1 * b1)
              total4 := d2 + (e2 * b2)
              '

But when I use the following syntax I get a warming message:
> full.fit <- lavaan::sem(full.model, data=DataSet_1, group="Emarket")
Warning message:
In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated ov variances are negative

I have used a similar model before with other variables and didn't get this warning message. What is the problem here?
